description: NEW structural change (not a parameter tweak): add a COCONUT 2.0 external-database fallback. When the exp_001 train-library retrieval is not confident (best matched-peak cosine < 0.05, or fewer than 25 distinct candidates), fill the remaining Top-25 slots with COCONUT 2.0 structures (474k distinct skeletons, Zenodo 13897038) matched by neutral monoisotopic mass (adduct-corrected, same 15ppm window), ranked by mass closeness only (no spectra available for COCONUT entries). Implemented in notebooks/spectral_retrieval_coconut_fallback.py. Run on Kaggle 2026-10-09 (kernel taichiii/enveda-casmi-2026-exp004-coconut-fallback v2); fallback fired on 24/400 molecules.
notes: CORRECTION: the cosine<0.05 branch never added anything when train already had 25 candidates (it only filled TOP_K-len(ranked) slots), so the fallback effectively fired only on the 24 molecules with <25 train candidates; widening the threshold alone would change nothing. | base_exp=exp_001 (LB 0.122). delta=+0.002. Small and within single-LB-sample noise in magnitude, but the fallback only fills empty Top-25 slots after train candidates (never overwrites), so on the same rerun test it cannot lower the score: sign is trustworthy. 判定: 採用 (new best 0.124, base for next experiments). Fallback only fired on 24/400 (6%) -- next single-change candidates: widen trigger threshold (cos<0.05 -> e.g. 0.2), or rank COCONUT candidates by Tanimoto to top train hits instead of mass closeness. | Smoke-test only, NOT the official local CV: run on a 393,216-row train subset (3 of 21 parquet row groups -- full 2.5M-row load OOMs this device sandbox, 3.8GB RAM) with 60 held-out molecules (seed 0), to check the code runs and produces a plausible qualitative effect, not to estimate the real score. 3/60 held molecules were present in COCONUT at all (matches the full-scale measurement: COCONUT ik14-overlap with train is only 25,945/275,810; COCONUT-only new structures=447,991). Rationale: test tiers per Discussion top-solution are ~10-15% exact library match (Tier1) / ~45-55% known structure, no library spectrum (Tier2) / ~30-40% fully novel (Tier3); COCONUT is a plausible recovery path for Tier2 since it is mostly disjoint from the train library. BEFORE a real submission: taichi needs to (1) upload coconut-10-2024.csv (or a smaller derived mass/smiles/inchikey14 table) as a Kaggle Dataset and attach it to the kernel (competition blocks internet at scoring time), (2) wire the Kaggle kernel inference.py to call rank_with_coconut_fallback instead of (or alongside) the exp_001 ranking, pointing CONF_THRESHOLD/paths at the attached dataset. 委託: なし.

description: Single structural change from exp_004 (LB 0.124): add mass-shift ANALOG PROPAGATION (simplified top-solution Channel 2) as a re-ranker. For each query spectrum also search train spectra (same adduct) whose precursor differs by a known chemical modification (+-H2, CH2, O, H2O, C2H4, CH2O, C2H2O, CO2, C5H8, SO3, HPO3, pentose, deoxyhexose, hexose, glucuronic acid; +-15ppm window at the shifted mass), scored by a modified cosine (query peak may match at m/z or m/z+shift). Structures of the best analogs (cos>=0.3, top10) are evidence; every candidate in the pool (exact-channel train structures top200 + mass-matched COCONUT top300) gets score = exact_cosine + 1.0 * max_i(analog_cos_i * Tanimoto(Morgan r2 2048)). Ties: train before COCONUT, then mass closeness, so molecules with no evidence rank exactly as exp_004. Kernel taichiii/enveda-casmi-2026-exp006-analog-propagation, script notebooks/kaggle_inference_exp006_analog_propagation.py.
cv_mean: 0.0764 (exp_006 order) vs 0.0291 (exp_004 order), smoke test only
notes: base_exp=exp_004 (LB 0.124). delta=+0.011 -- an order of magnitude larger than the +-0.002-0.004 moves of exp_002-005, so both sign and size are credible despite the single 400-molecule LB sample. 判定: 採用 (new best 0.135, base for next experiments). Kaggle run v2 (1044s, rdkit installed offline from Dataset taichiii/rdkit-wheel-cp313; v1 failed: no rdkit in the Kaggle image). Diagnostics on the public dummy test: analog evidence for 396/400 molecules, Top-1 changed vs exp_004 order 106/400, 251 COCONUT structures in Top-25 slots total, COCONUT at Top-1 0. Interpretation: structural evidence from analog spectra is the first thing that moved the score; exp_005 (tied) showed that merely making room for COCONUT does not. Open risk: Top-1 changed on 106 dummy molecules whose exact copy is in train, so W_ANALOG=1.0 may be demoting true Tier-1 hits -- next single changes: gate the re-rank by best exact cosine (keep exp_004 order when >= ~0.7), or lower W_ANALOG. | base_exp=exp_004 (exp_005 LB still pending; exp_006 is independent of exp_005 and does not include its low-confidence truncation). NOT monotone: evidence-backed COCONUT structures can push train candidates out of Top-25 and the exact-channel order can change. Smoke test (notebooks/smoke_test_exp006.py, 3 of 21 row groups = 393k rows, 60 held-out molecules, seed 0, 26 of them exist in COCONUT): exp_004-order MRR@25 0.0291 -> exp_006-order 0.0764; 49/60 molecules had analog evidence, COCONUT at Top-1 for 13. Seeds 1-2 drew row groups whose libraries have 0 COCONUT overlap (both orders 0.0000, uninformative). This is in-library leave-one-structure-out, relatives of the held-out structure sit in the same library, so it is optimistic and NOT an LB estimate. Vectorised cosine reproduces exp_005 cosine to 1.4e-14 (exact channel unchanged). Runtime on subset 0.1-0.3 s/molecule; rdkit required (in Kaggle image). Submitted 2026-10-10. 委託: なし.

notes: base_exp=exp_006 (LB 0.135). delta=-0.002 (within single-LB-sample noise in size, but the sign answers the pre-registered question: gating did NOT recover anything, so exp_006 was not losing Tier-1 hits; if anything the evidence re-rank also helps molecules with best exact cosine >= 0.7). 判定: 棄却 (keep exp_006 as best). Kaggle run v1 1037s; on the public dummy test exp_007 output == exp_004 output (all 309 molecules with train hits gated, the other 91 have no candidates at all), so the gate could only act on the hidden rerun test. Takeaway: do not protect the exact channel from the evidence term; next axis should be the evidence itself (more ANALOG_SHIFTS, evidence from the exact channel too, or W_ANALOG > 1) rather than restricting where it applies. | base_exp=exp_006 (LB 0.135). Motivation: on the public dummy test (train copies, so the exact copy is the answer) exp_006 changed Top-1 for 106/400 molecules, i.e. W_ANALOG=1.0 can demote a near-perfect library hit; real Tier-1 (~10-15%) are exactly the high-exact-cosine molecules, so the gate should only remove downside there. Expected: LB > 0.135 if Tier-1 hits were being lost, = 0.135 if not; lower would mean the evidence re-rank also helps high-cosine molecules (then try gate 0.9). No new smoke test (gate branch is exp_004 order, already validated). Submitted 2026-10-10. 委託: なし.
